work_unavailable: The upstream currently provides no details for this work, so it cannot be read. You can try fetching its details again later.
work_details_stale: The upstream currently provides no work details. Showing the saved cache.
image_failed: Image could not be loaded. Retry or refresh chapter details. If direct access remains unavailable, ask the administrator to select server mode.
empty: No pages are available for this chapter.
title: JMComic synchronization
policy: Metadata is stored on disk. Images are read on demand and never saved by the server.
disabled: Enable this storage to manage synchronization.
client: Client: browser fetches and restores images
export_policy: Images are fetched and packaged in this browser. Exports are limited to 3,000 pages and 256 MiB. On the work page, chapter export starts with the first chapter.
export_pdf_policy: PDF uses the first frame of animated GIFs and has a 64 MiB image budget.
export_error_cors: The upstream refused browser access (CORS) or the direct connection failed. Retry, refresh chapter metadata, or ask the administrator to select server mode. No proxy fallback was used.
export_error_image: An image could not be read or decoded. No partial file was downloaded.
export_error_limit: The browser export memory/page limit was exceeded. Export individual chapters instead.
export_error_empty: No readable pages are available for the selected chapters.
export_error_mode_changed: The storage mode or work changed while exporting. Refresh this page and try again.
tag_count_policy: All upstream-listed and locally discovered tags, ordered by the number of cached works (not the upstream total). Open a tag to load its work list.
